claims: As of March 2026, the Biden administration's Saving on a Valuable Education (SAVE) plan is effectively terminated following court orders.
Seven million+ borrowers must switch from SAVE to other repayment plans.
The SAVE plan offered 5% discretionary income payments.
The SAVE plan offered fast forgiveness.
SAVE borrowers have a 90-day window to switch to a legal plan.
The Department of Education is introducing a Repayment Assistance Plan with 30-year relief terms.
The Department of Education is introducing a Tiered Standard Plan.
The SAVE plan covered unpaid monthly interest so balances did not grow.
The SAVE plan reduced monthly payments to $0 for low-income borrowers under 225% of the poverty line.
The SAVE plan reduced monthly payments to 5% of discretionary income for undergraduates.
Enrolled SAVE borrowers were placed in interest-free forbearance while legal challenges occurred.
Large-scale student debt cancellation initiatives were largely struck down by the Supreme Court in 2023.
